verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Blessed be the name in the land of the plentiful
Where your streams of abundance flow
Blessed be Your name as i walk through this desert place
Though i walk through the wilderness

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Every blessing you pour out i’ll turn back to praise
When the darkness closes in Lord still i will say
Blessed be the name of the Lord blessed be Your name
Blessed be the name of the Lord blessed be Your glorious name

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Blessed be Your name when the sun’s shining down on me
When the world’s all as it should be blessed be The name
Blessed be the name on the road marked with suffering
Though there’s pain in the offering blessed be the Name

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
You give and take away
You give and take away
My heart will chose to say
Blessed be the Name (tutto x 2)

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Blessed be the name of the Lord blessed be Your name
Blessed be the name of the Lord blessed be Your glorious name (tutto 2 volte)
